name: Afterparty House
reference_use: Inspected portrait for style; generation used explicit style description from the supplied brief.

levels.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent isometric building sprite for an interactive Cancel City neighbourhood. NEW illustration. Reference portrait is STYLE ONLY: match its bold grotesque punk comic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, distressed screen-printed vivid colour, textured hand-drawn details. Show ONE complete building, detached, centered, full structure visible, three-quarter isometric view from diagonally above, orthographic game camera, vertical walls upright. Two visible front/side faces meet at center; ground base is a small diamond-like isometric square. Use the same approximately 30-degree isometric view for all assets. Frame comfortably inside a square canvas with clear transparent margin, preserve room above roof. Include ONLY the building and its own narrow ground footprint, no street, no sky, no background scenery, no large shadow extending outside footprint. TRUE alpha transparent background, not white or checkerboard painted background. NO card frame, UI, captions, readable text, watermark or real logos. High detail at least 1024 square; legible silhouette at 250px. Level 1 starting building, compact and modest but expressive. Palette: hot pink-purple. Subject: A crooked three-storey pink and purple nightlife townhouse, hot-pink striped awning, rooftop ring-light circle and a generic skull-shaped neon sign, giant outdoor speaker stacks, mismatched doors, warm pink windows, spray-painted abstract marks, little party streamers. Satirize celebrity ego and influencer apologies. No lettering, logos or identifiable people.
notes: Full isometric building visible; bold scratchy comic texture, pink/purple palette, striped awning, neon skull and ring light, rooftop speakers.
No readable lettering, logos, people or background scenery observed.
Negligible alpha=1 stray edge pixels; visible structure has clear transparent margins.
